name: 话语标记分析
description: 分析 the usage 模式 of 话语标记 (connectives, transitions) to differentiate AI生成的 from 人类撰写的 text.
useCase: 通过过多或过少使用衔接性话语连接词检测AI文本
mechanism: 识别 and quantifies 话语标记 (e.g., 'however', 'therefore', 'furthermore', 'in addition') and their positional 分布 内的 texts. AI生成的 text typically exhibits a narrower set of 话语标记 with more formulaic placement 模式. The method constructs a discourse marker profile and compares it against human reference 分布s using Jensen-Shannon divergence.
accuracy: 中等 - 73-83% 准确度 跨 domains
source: Kumarage et al. (2023) - Stylometric Detection of AI-Generated Text in Twitter Timelines, arXiv
algorithm: Discourse Marker Extraction + Positional Analysis + Distribution Comparison
parameters: Marker lexicon: 150+ markers, Position tracking: sentence-initial/medial/final, Frequency normalization: per-sentence, Comparison: JSD metric
strengths:
• Captures high-level text organization 模式
• Robust 跨 different text lengths
• Linguistically interpretable 特征
• Complements token-level 检测 methods
limitations:
• Marker inventory varies 跨 languages
• Genre-dependent baseline 分布s
• Advanced LLMs can produce varied discourse 模式
• Requires careful marker taxonomy definition

references.title: Kumarage, T. et al. (2023). Stylometric Detection of AI-Generated Text in Twitter Timelines. arXiv.
Halliday, M. A. K. & Hasan, R. (1976). Cohesion in English. Longman.
Zellers, R. et al. (2019). Defending Against Neural Fake News. NeurIPS.
